title: Maker Tuesday | Snapmaker U1 Feature Highlights and Discussion
description: Feature video of Snapmaker U1. Next-generation multi-color and multi-material 3D printer built for fast speed, efficiency, and creativity.

title: Custom Firmware for Snapmaker U1 - Enhanced Features & WebRTC Camera
description: Custom firmware adding SSH access, hardware-accelerated camera with WebRTC streaming. Warning: may void warranty.

title: U1 improvement: Manual Leveling Wizard
description: U1 now has an on-screen wizard to assist in manual bed leveling, added by beta tester request.

title: Add Direct U1 Printing & Toolhead/Filament Mapping to Vanilla OrcaSlicer
description: Request for vanilla OrcaSlicer support for U1 with same functionality as Snapmaker Orca. Users can connect to U1 via Fluidd in official OrcaSlicer.

title: Feature Request: Smooth Timelapse Mode with Fixed Printhead Position
description: Feature request for smooth timelapse mode. Current recordings show printhead glitching between frames.

title: Snapmaker Automatic Material Management (S.A.M.M)
description: Request for Snapmaker to build filament management system like Bambu/Anycubic/Creality. Praises U1 as 'this is how tool change is done.'

title: Feature Request: Manual Filament roll-over (on the fly)
description: Cannot manually select filament to replace run-out during print. Firmware 1.1.0 with 4 filaments loaded.

title: Feature Request - Wall and Top/Bottom layers Material Sequencing
description: Feature request for wall and top/bottom layer material sequencing in multimaterial prints.
